message.content: Based on the conversations between LiHua and Jake, LiHua considers Lionel Messi's exceptional abilities and attributes him the title of being the best soccer player. LiHua emphasizes Messi's playmaking ability and the creativity he brings to the game. She highlights Messi's work ethic and humility, noting that his approach to the sport sets a high standard for future generations of players. LiHua also points out his ability to create chances out of nothing and his vision on the field, which she believes are key factors in making Messi the best.
